description: This PHP source file defines an ORM entity class 'EmpLocations' for mapping employee location data within the OrangeHRM system. It specifies relationships to Employee and Location entities, including getter and setter methods for these properties.

classes.name: EmpLocations
classes.description: An ORM entity representing the association between an employee and a location in the HRM system, identified by composite primary key consisting of employee and location IDs.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee object associated with this location record.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee object for this location record.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Returns the Location object associated with this employee.

methods.name: setLocation
methods.description: Sets the Location object for this employee.
